en: A black-and-white photograph showing a dramatic mountainous landscape, likely in the Alps. Sheer rock faces and wide, terraced slopes dominate the center, with scattered snow patches on the highest peaks. In the foreground are dense forests, rocky outcrops, and a few isolated farmhouses or alpine buildings set in open meadows. A valley with a road or rail line runs along the base of the cliffs on the left. The image is bordered by a white margin, typical of vintage postcards, and there is no visible caption or printed text on the front.
